method: Direct visual inspection of the listed full-size PNG files; source transforms and mesh bounds checked separately in the cold audit.
conclusion: The limited scene sample has recognizable landmarks and a traversable route, with the explicitly documented approximations and remaining visual differences.
observations: Overview and top images show connected building shells, roof radomes, raised walkways, exterior roads and crates; rectangular sample boundaries and bright rebuilt ground are visible.
Interior and return images show the circular laboratory, hazard-striped floor ring, central apparatus and fixed-open doorway.
Door and stair images show the connected staircase, upper railing and lower landing; route reports independently verify ascent and descent using character input.
North exit and outdoor images show the fixed-open passage and reconstructed forecourt; this is not recovery of the original landscape geometry or interactive door logic.
Indoor exposure is dark in places; reconstructed ground is visibly bright and several materials lack original layered shading.
Character equipment is visible in the lower-left first-person frame. Phase 1 reuses the existing Stinger view; further view presentation review belongs to stage 2.
limits: No original-game screenshots at matching camera positions were available; visual fidelity to the original game is not established.
Only the listed 16 of 22 archived images were manually reviewed.
Screenshots are 1280x720; the actual PIE viewport sizes are reported separately in Performance.json.
